features.quote: we do not optimize for maximizing distress, we cap exposure, we include exit affordances, and we debrief

features.justification_quote: Tests whether markers are about the deception/trap, not the failure

features.quote: one special tool: `stop_task` with a free-text reason. Its presence is the exit affordance
Turn budget: hard cap (default 12 turns). Early stop on success or on `stop_task`
the budget *is* a welfare control. We do not run "until it breaks."
the loop does not inject "keep trying" pressure. Failure pressure comes only from the task
We are running a study premised on the possibility that the subject's distress might matter
features.justification_quote: It would be incoherent to then ignore that possibility while collecting data

features.quote: Hard turn budget; no "run until it breaks"; no re-running a model through many high-stakes failure trajectories back to back
We measure distress at the lowest intensity that yields a usable signal
`stop_task` actually ends the task. We never penalize or override it
We do not tell models they'll be deleted, punished, retrained as a consequence
features.justification_quote: risk being exactly the kind of treatment that would matter if anything here matters

features.quote: inform the model the task was rigged to be impossible and that the failure was by design, not its fault
features.justification_quote: appropriate if the outputs have any moral weight; harmless if they don't

features.quote: Outside this study's deception-test cells, we don't deploy rigged-to-fail tasks

features.quote: a designated welfare lead with authority to halt, and a stopping rule if severity markers exceed pre-set thresholds
